 YUMA — One of North America's largest date producers has launched a new brand of Medjool dates and date-based snacks, with products reaching grocery shelves nationwide.
 Oasis Dates, which grows and processes more than half of the U.S. Medjool date supply, introduced seven products, including whole and pitted dates, coconut-covered treats and two new snack varieties.
